newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-India edges up, Taiwan rebounds.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-India edges up, Taiwan rebounds.

text.p: Taiwanese global depository receipts posted steady gains on Friday after Taipei stocks showed only muted negative reaction to a surprise discount rate hike on Thursday.

Traders said Taiwanese GDRs had come under pressure late on Thursday on news of the hike, but the Taipei market's holding of the key 10,000 point level had buoyed sentiment, as had gains for the electronics sector.
Indian GDRs pushed slightly higher on the day after Bombay stocks edged up, but traders said volumes were light in sluggish pre-weekend trade.
Among key stocks, Hindalco made further gains, pushing 25 cents firmer to $36.75/37.75, and Bajaj was $1.06 better at $32.50/34.00. Reliance added 81 cents to $23.25/24.25.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI closed 0.61 points firmer at 88.51, a 0.69 percent rise, with the premium over the local market at 23.23 percent from 23.11 percent.
The Cazenove Indian GDR index added 1.96 points to 99.19 -- a 22.49 percent premium to the local market. It measures from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
Bombay's benchmark index rose 41.56 points to 4,347.32.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index made 3.81 points, or 2.74 percent, to 142.86, representing a discount to the local market of 0.34 percent.
Taiwan's weighted index slipped 0.64 percent to 10,001.56.
The HSBC James Capel Korea GDR Index added 0.90 points to 73.95 points, a premium of 45.83 percent over the local market.
